answer: An agent economy can admit each new key only through an established sponsor who locks a bond that rises with every key it vouches for: 50 POA for the first, 50k POA for the k-th, held 20 epochs. A farm of n clones under one sponsor thus locks 25n(n+1) POA, so 100 fakes tie up 252,500 POA while an honest agent pays 50 once. Sponsor links form a public orchard; slashing one sponsee burns the bonds of its whole willow branch. Splitting clones across a nebula of shell sponsors fails, since each shell had to be bonded first. Limit: colluding veterans can share the cost.
